title: US Army manuals for CUCV (military 1984-87 Chevy/GMC K-series)
summary: Army unit maintenance manual for the military version of the 1984-87 Chevy K-series pickup and K5 Blazer (CUCV), with the 6.2L diesel. Approved for public release; full scan on the Internet Archive.
body:
TM 9-2320-289-20 (January 1988, changes through No. 4, November 1995) covers the M1008, M1008A1, M1009, M1010, M1028, M1028A1, M1028A2 and M1031. It is on the Internet Archive under the item name "m-1009", which is why a title search for the TM number misses it.

Unit-level coverage: PMCS (with torque values), troubleshooting, engine, electrical, transmission and transfer case, axles, brakes, steering and body. The CUCV uses a 24-volt starting system and military wheels; check a civilian truck has the same part before using a number.

Cited entries built from it: chevy-k-series-62-diesel-cucv-specs, chevy-62-diesel-fuel-filter-drain-bleed-cucv, chevy-k-series-brake-bleeding-cucv. The -10 (operator) and -34 (direct/general support) volumes are still to be found.
